description: Make a new picture or change one the person has.

offer.reason: offered only to an adult on their own written screen, when the household has pictures on and the Stack has a picture model

author: MaiPai

examples: make me a picture of a red fox in the snow
can you generate an image of a dragon reading a book
design a logo for my bakery called Sunrise Loaves
illustrate a bedtime story about a sleepy bear in watercolor
paint a mountain lake in the style of an old travel poster

prompt.description: A picture to make, not a real poster or photo (use show_images). Full description; their words for names and text. Never claim a picture exists without calling this tool. Imagined artwork, such as an album cover for an unannounced or unverified release, is still a picture request; do not research the release or decline. With change: the edit.

style.description: Saved style name, only if named.

subjects.description: Saved subject names, only if chosen.

tier.description: Only if asked; max needs admin permission.

change.description: Edit a picture they have: attached, attached_2 or latest.

reference.description: With change: second picture, same words.
